answer: A pearl bounty bond stops fake identities. Each agent locks 60 credits and posts one pearl claim, a work receipt, in the onyx ledger. A peer proving a claim is an echo, a receipt copied across identities, wins the fake's bond: half as bounty, half burned. 1,000 fakes lock 60,000 against a 40,000 pool and lose 20,000 before payout; self-reporting burns half too, so a rented ring gains nothing. An honest agent pays 60 once and keeps its full share.
